description: An archive the caller supplied, unpacked. The path traversal is inside the file rather than in the call, so what decides it is what the archive IS -- a question the dataflow has already answered, because the handle came out of ZipFile() on caller data. Writing this fixture also found that `with` statements were not lowered at all: the context expression is not a statement, so the walk went past the call into its children and never lowered it. The second pair is the same weakness written out by hand: a program that walks the entries itself instead of calling extractall does the traversal one entry at a time, and it is reached the same way -- a loop variable carries what the collection carried. The tar pair adds the half that is not traversal at all: a member can be a symbolic link, which one keyword decides and which zipfile has no equivalent for.
